question: Should the agent-status dashboard widget be accepted now as a `sessions.list`-backed builtin in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826, or should this issue wait for the broader `sessions.activity.*` Gateway contract before being considered solved?
rationale: Automation can verify that current main lacks the feature and that an open PR exists, but it cannot choose the durable product/API boundary for task, progress, and attention state.

options.title: Use the staged dashboard builtin
options.body: Treat the linked PR as the implementation path, but require its source blockers, proof, and security/dependency review to clear before this issue closes.

options.title: Wait for activity API first
options.body: Keep this issue open until the broader per-session activity contract lands, then build the widget against the richer stable API.

options.title: Fold into the roadmap tracker
options.body: Move any unique status-widget details into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 and let the roadmap own sequencing after the linked PR is resolved.

recommendation.title: Use the staged dashboard builtin
recommendation.body: Treat the linked PR as the implementation path, but require its source blockers, proof, and security/dependency review to clear before this issue closes.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the strongest current-main routing signal for the session/API and Control UI boundary involved in the decision.
